thread:
olivia: Quick sync — need to align on phased affinity gating + cutover criteria for Q3 low-latency customers.

mike: TL;DR: customers want deterministic p95 < 120ms, plus evacuation window w/ 30m notice. Is that what we're proposing?

lena: yep. proposal: Phase 1 = soft-affinity routing + canary on 5% traffic; Phase 2 = hard slice w/ eviction SLA and circuit-breakers.

jordan: Customers asking for contractual cutover windows (2-week lead) and rollback plan. Sales flagged large customers (Acme, Nova) - @mike

mike: Acme wants no more than 2 cross-region failovers per quarter. Nova will accept eventual consistency? idk.

olivia: Need launch gates: runbook, automated rollback, test harness with synthetic traffic, and SLO dashboard. Also acceptance criteria: p95 <120ms for 1 hour under 2x baseline.

lena: Perf tests: k6 script + gen-load via /ops/test-harness. Example command:
```
k6 run -u 100 -d 10m --out influxdb=http://perf:8086 script.js
```

jordan: Ops ask: evacuation contract should include max data residency disruption <5min and notification webhooks.

eng-bot: [incident-bot] note: last scheduled migration increased p99 to 400ms for 7m (see #postmortems/2025-03-12)

mike: Can we ship Phase 1 with config flags? We should avoid a hard migration before dedicated infra is ready.

olivia: Yes — feature flags + canary routing. Gradual tenant moves with backfill KV-cache warmup.

lena: Migration steps draft:
1) soft-affinity -> 2) canary slice (5%) -> 3) warmup KV cache -> 4) full cutover -> 5) monitor and rollback window

jordan: Rollback criteria: error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR p95 >200ms for 5m -> auto-evacuate to fallback.

mike: Cost note: slicing increases GPU idle overhead ~8% per slice. Need sales to sign off on pricing impact.

olivia: Action items:
- lena: produce perf scripts + expected runbook by Thu
- mike: list customer cutover SLAs + commercial asks
- jordan: draft evacuation webhook spec
- olivia: coordinate with product legal for contract language

lena: will do. I'll tag measurement thresholds in the dashboard.

mike: I'll ping Acme & Nova to confirm acceptance window.

olivia: Thanks all. Quick poll: can we commit to Phase 1 pilot in 3 weeks? :thumbsup:/:thumbsdown:

lena: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

olivia: Great — let's sync Wed 10am to review perf runs. Agenda: runbook, rollback, pricing impact.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: Canary routing flag enabled on staging (deploy 5240), logs: https://deploys.internal/5240
